## Summary

Describe the problem, the chosen solution, and any compatibility or API impact.

## Validation

- [ ] I added or updated deterministic tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I ran the relevant Release build/tests and the formatting check.
- [ ] Crypto, wire-format, and program-layout changes include an upstream or independent compatibility vector.
- [ ] Untrusted-input bounds, allocation behavior, secret handling, and exception/log content were reviewed.
- [ ] Public API XML docs and relevant README/usage/changelog documentation are updated.
- [ ] Dependency changes include the affected lock files; workflow actions remain pinned to full commit SHAs.
- [ ] This change does not contain private keys, credentials, generated build output, or unrelated edits.

## References

Link the issue, upstream source revision, specification, or advisory used to validate the change.
